name: Training success
description: Every round of a gym training succeeds, so each one raises the stat. The TP cost, the gains and the bonus round's question are the game's. Takes effect from the next training session.

options.name: Bonus round
options.description: Game: the bonus round keeps the game's chance (about 3 in 4 for trainings that start it by themselves, 1 in 2 for those that ask, almost none for the same bonus twice in a row). Always: it succeeds too, except the same training's bonus twice in a row. Always, even twice: it succeeds every time.
